title: Does LLM Focus on the Right Words? Mitigating Context Bias in LLM-based Recommenders

bias_targets.methodology: Feature Ablation Attribution (FAA) to quantify the influence of auxiliary tokens (e.g., task descriptions) versus core user interaction tokens on model predictions, and evaluating the recommendation distribution across item groups based on their semantic relevance to auxiliary tokens using fairness metrics like MGU@K and DGU@K.
